notes.title: Knightfall: a daring journey is FREE! 🌹
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone, after a few months of discussions with the community and with the team, we have decided to make Knightfall: A Daring Journey free starting today![/b][/h3]

The game currently doesn’t have enough active players to populate servers to start games and we don’t want to charge people for a game they can’t play. By making the game free we will hopefully get more full games going!

We want to thank all of you who have supported the game so far and we hope you can gather some of your friends up to play some rounds once it goes free next week.

If you recently got the game you may still be able to refund it through [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/784C-923B-A4A1-C825]Steam[/url].

If you have any questions or concerns about the game going free please reach out to us directly at support@landfall.se

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42198690/d43a444c233e3b2c53cb4cb48f2c957969ca63b8.png[/img]

notes.title: Knightfall is becoming free on June 18th
notes.content:
[h3]Knightfall is becoming free on June 18th![/h3]

[b]Hello everyone, after a few months of discussions with the community and with the team, we have decided to make Knightfall: A Daring Journey free from the 18th of June at 9AM Pacific time![/b]

The game currently doesn’t have enough active players to populate servers to start games and we don’t want to charge people for a game they can’t play. By making the game free we will hopefully get more full games!

We want to thank all of you who have supported the game so far and we hope you can gather some of your friends up to play some rounds once it goes free next week. 

If you recently got the game you may still be able to refund it through [url=https://help.steampowered.com/en/faqs/view/784C-923B-A4A1-C825]Steam[/url].

[b]If you have any questions or concerns about the game going free please reach out to us directly at support@landfall.se [/b]

notes.title: Landfall Archives: 23 unreleased Landfall projects!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone! It’s time for Landfall Day and this year we’re releasing not 1, not 4 but 23 different games and projects as their own little experience! [/b][/h3]

Landfall Archives is a collection of every project Landfall and friends have worked on since 2016 that didn't make it to shelves but deserves to see the light of day.

[h2][b]Landfall Archives is free and can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353760/Landfall_Archives]here[/url]![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=X4xWDjmmt7o;full][/previewyoutube]

As you may know, we have a yearly tradition of releasing a smaller project we've made on April 1st such as Knightfall: A Daring Journey last year. We hope you enjoy this year's project! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42198690/532dc3d7c1e2e2d06e9a0bdce457c4bf04598994.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]To celebrate Landfall Day most of our games are also 50-90% off on steam! So if there’s one you’ve been eager to play, now is the time. You can find all of our games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/landfallgames]here[/url]![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Knightfall Update 3! New Town, weapons and enchantments!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Time for update 3 (yes, the actual update 3 this time)[/b]

[h3]New weapons and enchantments:[/h3]

[b]Enchantments: [/b]
Sonar: Reveals enemies in an area around the bullet/bomb impact.
Restoration: Gives you healing bombs or bullets.
Vampirism: Can now also appear as a bomb enchantment and gives the same stats as the weapon enchantment.

[b]Two spellbooks:[/b]
Ice bolt: Launches an ice projectile that slows Enemies that are hit.
Ignite: Fires a volley of projectiles that light enemies on fire when hit.

[h3]New town! [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/85c2db9acb33fc92bdc3b148affa68f974a75b73.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/26085258/e5cb516cdd37dabe7bdace96b342e09136ad5085.png[/img]

[h3]Patch Notes
[/h3]
[b]Added:[/b]
[list]
[*] 2 new weapons
[*] 2 new weapons enchantments
[*] 3 new bomb enchantments
[*] 1 new town
[*] 2 new spawns
[*] Added the ability to place a marker for your team
[*] Added quality options for models and shadows
[/list]
[b]Changed:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the number of players per match to 28
[*] Changed the Rose Castle and added more paths and rooms
[/list]
[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Some performance improvements
[/list]

Make sure to verify the integrity of the game-files!

notes.title: Knightfall Update 1! New weapons and private games! 🏹

notes.title: Knightfall: Patch 2 - Go forth without the fort!
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Thank you all for playing, seeing the response to the game has been incredible and we hope to spend the weekend fixing some of the issues you've reported to us. 
[/b]

[b]Patch notes: [/b]
[list]
[*] Removed West Fort and East Fort to allow for bigger battles at the final castle.
[*] Optimized audio implementation performance. This should give players slightly better frame rates
[/list]
[b]
Make sure to restart the game completely and verify the integrity of the game-files in order to recieve the patch! [/b]

notes.title: Knightfall: A Daring Journey Patch 1!
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Thank you for playing the game, this is our first patch for Knightfall: A Daring Journey!

We're also looking at making it easier to understand the game as a first-time player for a future patch. 

[h3]Patch notes:[/h3]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Remade some of the roads
[*] Made the days a bit longer
[*] Added wrong-way signs
[*] Renamed Fort to Outpost
[*] Renamed the East and West castles to East and West Fort
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Removed the horse being able to reverse run on grass
[*] Removed friendly fire
[*] Fixed bug where you would sometimes die at the game start
[/list]

Make sure to verify the integrity of the game files!
